title: Blender exporter fails when scene contains empty objects when custom props export is selected
body:
##### Description of the problem

When trying to export a Blender scene which contains objects of type "Empty", the export fails when the 'Custom props' checkbox is selected. This happens whether or not the Empty object contains any custom properties. 

If the 'Export' checkbox for the empty object is unchecked, the export completes correctly, even when the empty object does contain custom properties. The empty object is of course not exported in this case. 

This is the stack trace when export fails:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/__init__.py", line 812, in execute
    exporter.export_scene(filepath, settings)
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/__init__.py", line 20, in inner
    func(filepath, options, *args, **kwargs)
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/__init__.py", line 51, in export_scene
    scene_.parse()
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/scene.py", line 108, in parse
    self._parse_objects()
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/scene.py", line 230, in _parse_objects
    obj = object_.Object(node, parent=self[constants.OBJECT])
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/object.py", line 12, in __init__
    self._node_setup()
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/object.py", line 146, in _node_setup
    self[constants.USER_DATA] = api.object.custom_properties(self.node)
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/api/object.py", line 53, in inner
    return func(obj, *args, **kwargs)
  File "/home/tbu/.config/blender/2.77/scripts/addons/io_three/exporter/api/object.py", line 253, in custom_properties
    return {kvp[0]: kvp[1] for kvp in obj.data.items() if kvp[0][:1] != '_' and isinstance(kvp[1], constants.VALID_DATA_TYPES)}
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'items'

location: <unknown location>:-1
```
##### Three.js version
- [X] Dev
- [X] r77
- [X] r76

Blender v 2.77
##### OS

Tested on linux, probably all of them
